first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An adult man with short light-brown-and-gray hair combed back, wearing a near-black suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: The grayish-brown rough wall behind Person A and around the outside of the stairs, with locally lighter-colored areas on its surface.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A dark wooden architectural structure comprising thick vertical posts, horizontal beams, diagonal components, and stairs.

entities.name: Reddish-brown plane at the far end
entities.identification: A reddish-brown-gray plane with rectangular block-like divisions, deep in the center of the top-down view.

entities.name: Central vertical shaft opening
entities.identification: A central dark opening enclosed by multiple levels of wooden stairs and horizontal beams and extending downward.
